name: Step-Up
steps: Stand tall facing a sturdy box with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or ready at your sides.
Place your entire working foot firmly flat on top of the box.
Press through your planted foot and straighten that knee and hip to rise onto the box.
Lower your trailing foot slowly back to the floor under control, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Let the elevated leg do the lifting instead of springing off your rear toes on the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking straight over your toes without collapsing inward.
